lore: A short book for people who hum while they build.
use: The Simple Music Guide explains sheet music, note code, the disc press and the pocket jukebox. Craft it shapeless from a book and a note block.
secret: Its pages open in your language and nothing is consumed.

lore: Paper, ink and a feather: everything a song needs to be written down.
use: Shapeless from paper, an ink sac and a feather. Use it to open the note code editor; signing it with a title makes it read-only. A sheet holds a composition or an uploaded track.
secret: A signed sheet over an empty one in the cartography table makes a copy; only the empty sheet is used up.

lore: A piston that only ever presses music.
use: A piston over two iron ingots over three smooth stone. Put a sheet on top and blank discs below: it presses the sheet's music onto a blank in 2 seconds.
secret: The sheet always stays; only the blank becomes a disc.

lore: A disc that has not heard anything yet.
use: Four coal or charcoal and four blackstone around an amethyst shard. The disc press puts the music of a sheet onto it.
secret: A pressed composition gets a paper label, an uploaded track an amethyst one.

lore: Your own music, pressed to keep.
use: Carries an uploaded track or a composition. It plays once in a Vanilla jukebox; the pocket jukebox takes track discs.
secret: A track disc holds only the track's name, length and uploader, never the audio itself.

use: Holds up to 20 discs. Use it in the main hand to play or pause; only you hear it, wherever you go. Sneak and right-click a block to put it down.
secret: Placed on a block it plays its discs for everyone nearby, like a jukebox.
